package requestfilesystem

import (
	"os"
	"slices"
	"testing"

	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/json"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/project"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/vfs"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/vfs/vfstest"
)

type scenario struct {
	Name          string `json:"name"`
	CaseSensitive bool   `json:"caseSensitive"`
	Cwd           string `json:"cwd"`
	Host          struct {
		Files    map[string]string `json:"files"`
		Symlinks map[string]string `json:"symlinks"`
	} `json:"host"`
	Steps   []RequestFileSystem `json:"steps"`
	Queries []string            `json:"queries"`
}

type statOut struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Size  int64  `json:"size"`
	IsDir bool   `json:"isDir"`
	Mode  uint32 `json:"mode"`
}

type entriesOut struct {
	Files       []string `json:"files"`
	Directories []string `json:"directories"`
	Symlinks    []string `json:"symlinks"`
}

type queryOut struct {
	Path            string     `json:"path"`
	FileExists      bool       `json:"fileExists"`
	DirectoryExists bool       `json:"directoryExists"`
	ReadFile        *string    `json:"readFile"`
	Realpath        string     `json:"realpath"`
	Entries         entriesOut `json:"entries"`
	Stat            *statOut   `json:"stat"`
}

type stepOut struct {
	Error   string     `json:"error"`
	Changed []string   `json:"changed"`
	Created []string   `json:"created"`
	Deleted []string   `json:"deleted"`
	Outside bool       `json:"includesOutside"`
	Queries []queryOut `json:"queries"`
}


func TestZZDump(t *testing.T) {
	in, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("SCENARIOS"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Skip("no SCENARIOS")
	}
	var scenarios []scenario
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &scenarios); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	out := map[string][]stepOut{}
	for _, sc := range scenarios {
		files := map[string]any{}
		for k, v := range sc.Host.Files {
			files[k] = v
		}
		for k, v := range sc.Host.Symlinks {
			files[k] = vfstest.Symlink(v)
		}
		var fs vfs.FS = vfstest.FromMap(files, sc.CaseSensitive)
		var steps []stepOut
		for i := range sc.Steps {
			var changes project.FileChangeSummary
			next, err := NewForUpdate(&sc.Steps[i], fs, sc.Cwd, &changes)
			step := stepOut{}
			if err != nil {
				step.Error = err.Error()
			} else {
				fs = next
				for u := range changes.Changed.Keys() {
					step.Changed = append(step.Changed, string(u))
				}
				for u := range changes.Created.Keys() {
					step.Created = append(step.Created, string(u))
				}
				for u := range changes.Deleted.Keys() {
					step.Deleted = append(step.Deleted, string(u))
				}
				slices.Sort(step.Changed)
				slices.Sort(step.Created)
				slices.Sort(step.Deleted)
				step.Outside = changes.IncludesWatchChangeOutsideNodeModules
			}
			for _, q := range sc.Queries {
				r := queryOut{Path: q, FileExists: fs.FileExists(q), DirectoryExists: fs.DirectoryExists(q), Realpath: fs.Realpath(q)}
				if c, ok := fs.ReadFile(q); ok {
					r.ReadFile = &c
				}
				e := fs.GetAccessibleEntries(q)
				r.Entries = entriesOut{Files: e.Files, Directories: e.Directories}
				for s := range e.Symlinks {
					r.Entries.Symlinks = append(r.Entries.Symlinks, s)
				}
				slices.Sort(r.Entries.Symlinks)
				if info := fs.Stat(q); info != nil {
					r.Stat = &statOut{Name: info.Name(), Size: info.Size(), IsDir: info.IsDir(), Mode: uint32(info.Mode())}
				}
				step.Queries = append(step.Queries, r)
			}
			steps = append(steps, step)
		}
		out[sc.Name] = steps
	}
	b, err := json.Marshal(out)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("SCENARIOS_OUT"), b, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
